A modern, fast and friendly interface for **Gramps Web** — built for the whole family, from the
genealogist at the desk to the grandparents on their phone.

Your data, users, permissions and background jobs stay exactly where they are: this release replaces
only the user interface and talks to the unchanged Gramps Web API.

> **Early stage.** Everything Gramps Web can do is in, and it is designed to be fully compatible —
> but this is a first preview. Back up your data, try it, and tell us what you find.

## Highlights

- **People first** — large portraits, a life story told by years, families shown as faces.
- **Fast** — lists with thousands of people scroll instantly; edits refresh exactly what changed.
- **Phones and tablets** — tab bar, bottom sheets, swipeable photos, installable as an app.
- **Family tree charts** — ancestors, descendants, hourglass, fan and relationship paths.
- **Map and timeline** — places and events across time, with historic map overlays.
- **Full editing** — people, families, events, places, sources, citations, repositories, notes and
  media, incl. photo uploads, face regions and OCR.
- **And the rest** — full-text search, blog, tasks, bookmarks, change history with undo, reports,
  export/import, DNA matches, user management.
- **Dark and light theme, German and English.**

## Try it in two minutes

It's a drop-in replacement: swap the image of `grampsweb` and `grampsweb_celery` in your existing
docker-compose and restart.

    image: ghcr.io/b21-agency/gramps-ui:latest

Prefer to keep the classic UI running side by side? Add the `latest-proxy` image as an extra
service. Both ways are described in the [README](../../#get-the-new-ui). Switching back is just as quick.

## Help shape it

This is a community project and your feedback decides what comes next.

- 💬 Ideas, wishes, questions → [Discussions](../../discussions)
- 🐞 Bugs → [Issues](../../issues) (steps, browser/device and Gramps Web version help a lot)
- 🌍 Translations, phone testing and accessibility feedback are especially welcome."}
